picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award tasks Brookhaven National Lab and Stony Brook with building a foundation model for the national electric grid — a flagship federal AI infrastructure investment with direct implications for grid resilience amid AI-driven power demand.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: Notre Dame's AIM for Scale received $10M as part of a $60M OpenAI Foundation commitment to bring AI weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of smallholder farmers worldwide — a rare case of AI research translating into large-scale humanitarian impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's new AWS-powered Innovation Hub pairs a major cloud provider with academic medicine to accelerate clinical AI deployment, signaling deepening ties between big tech and health systems.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative pairs government, industry, and academia to modernize critical minerals extraction with AI — a strategically important supply-chain priority.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: NIST's $30M+ disbursement to Manufacturing Extension Partnership centers across 11 states and Puerto Rico will help small and mid-size manufacturers adopt AI and robotics — a broad federal push to diffuse AI capability into the industrial base.
picks.title: NIST Awards More Than $30 Million for MEP Centers in 11 States and Puerto Rico

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot with CSIRO, the University of Queensland, and industry partners is making AI data-center GPU workloads dynamically shiftable to ease strain on power grids — a novel technical approach to a growing global energy problem.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets

picks.editorial_note: Science Tokyo, Kanagawa Prefecture, and Fujifilm are extending a major cohort study using AI-based 3D MRI analysis to catch knee degeneration before symptoms appear — a concrete industry-academia effort toward earlier disease prevention.
picks.title: 痛みが出る前の膝の変化をMRIで捉える | Science Tokyo - 東京科学大学

picks.editorial_note: University of Houston chemists combined AlphaFold AI screening with atomic magnetometer sensing to fight antibiotic-resistant superbugs like MRSA, backed by a $1.26M NIH grant — a tangible application of AI protein-structure prediction to a public health threat.
picks.title: University of Houston Awarded $1.26M NIH Grant to Outsmart Superbugs | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: A UAB researcher's foundation-model framework combining electronic health records with RNA sequencing to predict cancer treatment response points toward more personalized, AI-guided oncology care.
picks.title: How one researcher is working toward AI use for cancer patient treatment

picks.editorial_note: A Virginia Tech alum's startup MorphLabs is building noninvasive AI-powered brain-computer bridges to let amputees control prosthetics — a striking real-world translation of university research into assistive technology.
picks.title: Engineering alum's medical startup aims to empower amputees with AI-linked prosthetics
picks.university: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University
